editorial:
Imagine meeting someone who seems way too perfect to be real. That is exactly what you get with Daisy. She looks like she has her whole life together, but she has a scary secret: she is obsessed with Ramona. While Ramona is just a normal person making mistakes, Daisy thinks she can fix her. The movie feels like a slow burn that turns into a nightmare. You will feel the tension grow as Daisy starts following Ramona and trying to control every little part of her life. It is a creepy ride that makes you wonder if anyone is actually as perfect as they seem on the outside.

The acting is the best part here because the lead actress makes you feel uneasy without even saying a word. The plot twists are surprising and the pacing keeps you on the edge of your seat. One downside is that some parts feel a bit slow, but the payoff is worth it. If you love stories about stalkers and mind games, you need to see this.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, you find out that Daisy has already replaced other people in her life before Ramona. The big twist is that Daisy kidnaps Ramona and tries to force her to act like a puppet. However, Ramona manages to trick Daisy and escapes during a fight in the basement. The movie ends with Ramona safe, but the final shot shows Daisy watching her from a distance, meaning the nightmare is not actually over.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers and stories about obsession.
